method: CUA actual browser UI flows; manual observations, not an unattended regression script

checks.name: Existing version 4 save loads into version 5
CV launches three squadrons of four aircraft
CVL launches two squadrons of three aircraft
US, UK, JP and DE wing selections and original aircraft sprites
Select SBD squadron and right-click a destination; only that squadron moves
Right-click enemy ship issues an independent bomber attack
Enemy automatic anti-air damages attacking aircraft
Turn handover changes left ship list to active player's ships
BB artillery attacks at expanded range with original shell sprites
DD torpedo attacks five hexes away with original torpedo sprites
Recall all returns aircraft and clears list without page reload
1440 x 1050 desktop layout and 1280 x 720 / 980 x 800 compact layouts remain operable
Local game health endpoint responds successfully

limits: Large simultaneous aircraft counts, AI, multiplayer and full-match balance were not tested.
No permanent hangar attrition or offline combat replay in this prototype.
